question: The Andaman and Nicobar Islands comprise about ______ islands.
solution:
The correct answer is __**572.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• **Andaman and Nicobar **Islands is a group of 572 islands/islets located at the juncture of the Bay of Bengal and the Andaman Sea.
 
• **Murga Island, Aves Island and Baratang Island **are some of the important islands of the Andaman Group of Islands. 
 
• Geopolitically, the ANI connects South Asia with South-East Asia.
 
• While the northernmost point of the archipelago is only 22 nautical miles from Myanmar, the southernmost point, Indira Point, is a mere 90 nautical miles from Indonesia.
 
• The islands dominate the Bay of Bengal, the Six Degree and the Ten Degree Channels that more than sixty thousand commercial vessels traverse each year.
 
• The “six-degree channel” lies between **Great Nicobar and Sumatra.**
 
• **Duncan's passage** separates **Little Andaman from South Andaman. **
